name: Convex Optimisation
strandNote: All roles: portfolio construction, model fitting and execution.
description: Recognise convex problems, solve portfolios through the KKT conditions and check a solver.

lessonNames.l3-local-is-global: Why a local minimum is global
lessonNames.l6-corners: The best point is a corner
lessonNames.l7-lp-in-code: Solving a linear programme in code
lessonNames.l8-lp-duality: The dual of a linear programme
lessonNames.l12-long-only: Long-only portfolios as a quadratic programme
lessonNames.l14-gradient-descent: Gradient descent and its step size

lessonObjectives.l1-convex-sets: Prove a set is convex, including the set of long-only weights.
lessonObjectives.l2-convex-functions: Test a function for convexity with the chord, the gradient and the Hessian.
lessonObjectives.l3-local-is-global: Prove that a local minimum of a convex function on a convex set is global.
lessonObjectives.l4-recognising-convex-problems: Tell whether an optimisation problem is convex, and rewrite one that is convex in disguise.
lessonObjectives.l5-linear-programmes: Write a trading or allocation problem as a linear programme.
lessonObjectives.l6-corners: Show that a linear programme’s optimum sits at a vertex, and find it on a picture.
lessonObjectives.l7-lp-in-code: Solve a linear programme with SciPy and read its status and slack.
lessonObjectives.l8-lp-duality: Write the dual of a linear programme and check that the optimal values match.
lessonObjectives.l9-lagrangian-dual: Form a Lagrangian dual and prove weak duality.
lessonObjectives.l10-kkt: State the KKT conditions and solve a small inequality-constrained problem with them.
lessonObjectives.l11-mean-variance-kkt: Solve a constrained mean-variance problem through the KKT conditions by hand.
lessonObjectives.l12-long-only: Solve a long-only portfolio as a quadratic programme and match a solver.
lessonObjectives.l13-shadow-prices: Read a multiplier as the value of relaxing a constraint, such as a position limit.
lessonObjectives.l14-gradient-descent: Run gradient descent and choose a step size from the curvature.
lessonObjectives.l15-convergence-rates: Link descent’s convergence rate to the condition number of the Hessian.
lessonObjectives.l16-newton-for-minimising: Minimise with Newton’s method and see quadratic convergence near the optimum.
lessonObjectives.l17-checking-a-solver: Check a solver’s answer with the KKT conditions and the duality gap.
